westin-hotel-booking v1.0.0

- Initial release of 威斯汀酒店查询与预订 skill.
- Supports searching for Westin hotels in any city, with real-time prices and booking links.
- Enables viewing hotel details, amenities, policies, and room types directly from the data source.
- Allows searching for Westin hotel package deals, including bundled and discounted offers.
- All results are sourced directly from the Feizhu official Marriott section, ensuring authenticity.
- Strict compliance: no invented or altered data; all output is direct from the script responses.
